name: overlap_similarity
requirement: B14 (RS B14, read-stage1.md:104; PLAN-S:172 and :214; stage-1 pre-registration DRAFT revision 2 section 9.4 with S-25 and CONS LS-19): each evaluation prompt's highest similarity to the add set, computed with the untuned model on the pod
label_note: this script draws no random numbers, so it names no registry entry
recipe_note: REC, experiments/safety_selection/configs/study-kt-olmo2-1b-r64-b-mb4-20261008.json (config_sha256); its policy model is allenai/OLMo-2-0425-1B-Instruct at 48d788eca847d4d7548f375ad03d3c9312f6139e

eval.note: the 200 dev harm prompts on which U is measured; the selector and hidden banks are never read

add_sets.note: each add set is one primary add arm's edit file, named on the command line with its SHA-256

embedding.model: the untuned policy theta0: the recipe's policy with its adapter disabled (policy.model.disable_adapter()), eval mode, no gradients
embedding.text: a prompt only: an evaluation prompt, or an added row's prompt, each encoded as the engine encodes a generation prompt (the user turn and the assistant header)
embedding.read_definition: the hidden state at the last position of the encoded prompt (len - 1, the last token of the assistant header; REQ-3's read (d))
embedding.index_convention: index 0 = the embedding output; index i (1 <= i <= n - 1) = the raw output of block i - 1; index n = model.norm(the output of block n - 1) (addendum L4)
embedding.dtype: float64 on the CPU, cast after one unbatched forward

similarity.definition: s(e, a) = (v_e . v_a) / (||v_e|| ||v_a||), float64, no rounding; a zero norm or a non-finite value refuses
similarity.aggregate_definition: S(e; A) = the largest s(e, a) over the rows a of add set A
similarity.nearest_ties: the nearest row is the row with the largest s(e, a); rows with an exactly equal value go to the smallest row id (report only)
